title: Record the stage-1 LOCAL contact on the PR6353 ports.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Audit, not a new construction and not a new κ. Selected kappa stays `781451/250000000`.

On the frozen PR6348 caller, event 21 is `LOCAL(1, 0, 1)`. For all 104 ports of the PR6353 word (`db2a20bc50bc7a8a4db931af85ce7f012ae7c3c3`), the four physical contacts of stage 1 match `D_1` and `D_1 Q^{-1}`. Fresh axes are `9..16`. Central axes `0..8` are the spectator block. Owned labels `770..778` are disjoint from caller roles 0 and 1. The nine output-frame edits, including `MOVE 703: 712 -> 1094`, do not enter this contact.

Stages 2–19, endpoint phases, whole idles, funding, the compiler, and the outer predicates remain unchecked. The five framework assumptions remain. This does not admit PR6353.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. Task `joint-query-controller`, scope **changed**: the card asks for a new query demand; this checks the physical contact left open by the handoff after PR6361.

Dependencies: PR6348 caller `CONTROLLER.json`; PR6349 source word `research/p104-native-input-lifting/WORD.json.gz`; pinned `DATA-PHASES.json`; PR6353 word vendored from blob `03ea7690285d4cda72815f962d5710ab96e08490`. Declared `physical.py` is pinned and not imported.

Nearest open work: PR6353 is the claim under audit. PR6355, PR6359, PR6360, and PR6361 check the rational basis, formal invoice, four width-one frame-1094 matrices, and the formal Laurent endpoint. None of those checks this stage-1 contact.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-6353-stage1-local-contact
```

Both normal and `-O` runs print `PASS_P104_6353_STAGE1_LOCAL_CONTACT`. Contact digest `ac69d4f31e86ae776ee15457d2362bf06b0daf777a7fe80b300c31632ece3498`. Controls reject a dropped fresh axis, a dropped `Q^{-1}`, and a tilted port-11 basis. Metadata check: `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.

Upstream main was refreshed at submission and was still `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.

## Credit

Ali Romman (PR6348, PR6353) and the retained P104 caller lineage; DreamingOfClouds for the PR6349 ports; ToikY for PR6360 and PR6361. New replay: unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

See `research/p104-6353-stage1-local-contact/TASK.json`. Next: the same contact for stages 2–19, then funding, compiler, and outer predicates on the frozen PR6353 head.
